# AlloyDisorderEngineering

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deliberate introduction of controlled compositional disorder in a photonic lattice to create topological phases without breaking time-reversal invariance. Offers a practical fabrication route for topological photonic devices, bridging materials science with neuromorphic and interconnect hardware.
